name: Deiva Mani Kailasam
title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack, AI)
bio: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack, AI) with 9 years of experience building GenAI-enabled, cloud-native, multi-tenant SaaS platforms on AWS and Azure using Python, TypeScript, Node.js, Java/Spring Boot, React, Angular, and Next.js. Delivered production systems combining intelligent backend services, interactive data-rich frontends, and strong platform engineering foundations, including distributed APIs handling 10K+ daily requests and products serving 100K+ users. Specialized in GenAI and agentic applications using RAG, tenant-scoped embeddings, LLM-powered analytics, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, and Snowflake Cortex, deployed to production via AWS services. Brings end-to-end ownership across business process, architecture, implementation, testing, CI/CD, observability, reliability, governance and mentoring.
